C002:144.summary: Crew C002 on Sol 144 shows elevated risk with amber CRI trajectory.
drivers: Cardiovascular strain (Sol 144: HR 84.8 bpm, HRV 40.5 ms)
Solar particle event acute radiation spike (Sol 144: 5.12 mSv)

suggestedActions.title: Solar Particle Event Habitat Storm Shelter
suggestedActions.protocol: Remain in designated habitat storm shelter module until active dosimeter measures normal transit baseline (<2.0 mSv/day); rescheduling pending EVA spacewalk activities suggested for flight surgeon review.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Radiation Health Bio-Protection Guidelines

suggestedActions.title: Autonomic Deconditioning and Fluid Rebalancing
suggestedActions.protocol: Ingestion of monitored fluid and electrolyte countermeasure solutions and use of lower body compression garments suggested for flight surgeon review to relieve cardiac strain.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Cardiovascular Deconditioning and Autonomic Regulation

suggestedActions.title: Cardiac Pacing and Workload Adjustment
suggestedActions.protocol: Operational physical workload reduction and dedicated restorative rest periods suggested for flight surgeon review to support autonomic recovery.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Cardiovascular Deconditioning and Autonomic Regulation

C002:144.disclaimer: Risk flags and suggested countermeasures only. Not a medical diagnosis.

C001:140.summary: Crew member C001 on Sol 140 is stable with no action needed.

suggestedActions.title: Continue routine monitoring
suggestedActions.protocol: Continue routine biometric monitoring and nominal mission operations.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Behavioral Health & Performance in Deep Space Habitats
